notes.title: The reported phase 49 bug has been fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for letting me know in the community that there was a bug in phase 49. It has been fixed, I believe the cat will roll normally now. If you encounter another problem please let me know!

notes.title: The bug in level 40 achievement has been fixed.
notes.content:
The bug in level 40 achievement has been fixed.

Anyone who has already passed level 40 but has not gained the achievement just needs to open the level and the achievement will be conquered.

I'm so sorry for the inconvenience and thank you so much for letting me know about the bug in the community!

notes.title: The Bug has beeen fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

The save system bug reported in the community has been fixed! Thank you so much for the feedback!!

I hope everyone has a good time with the game!

Kind regards,
Leticia!
